chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hammad ibn Isa, from Sawwar, from Al-Hasan, who said:

Indeed, when Ali عليه السلام defeated Talhah and Al-Zubayr, the people came fleeing in defeat. They passed by a pregnant woman on the roadside, and she was frightened by them, so she cast out what was in her womb alive; then he convulsed until he died, and afterward the woman died.

He said: Then Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام and his companions passed by her while she was lying there, and her child was on the road. He asked them about her case, and they said to him: She had been pregnant and was frightened when she saw the fighting and the defeat. So he asked them: Which of the two died before the other? They said: Her son died before her.

He said: Then he summoned her husband, the father of the deceased boy, and made him inherit two-thirds of the diyyah from his son, and made his deceased mother inherit one-third of the diyyah. He said: Then he made the husband inherit from his deceased wife half of the diyyah which she had inherited from her deceased son, and he made the relatives of the deceased woman inherit the remainder.

He said: Then he also made the husband inherit from the diyyah of the deceased woman half of the diyyah, which was two thousand five hundred dirhams, because she had no child other than the one whom she cast out when she was frightened; and he made the relatives of the deceased inherit the remainder. He said: Then all of that was paid from the treasury of Basra.

key_terms.الْغُلَامِ الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased boy whose diyyah and estate were distributed
key_terms.بَيْتِ مَالِ الْبَصْرَةِ: the public treasury of Basra from which the compensation was paid
key_terms.ثُلُثَ الدِّيَةِ: one-third of the blood money assigned as an inheritance share
key_terms.ثُلُثَيِ الدِّيَةِ: two-thirds of the blood money assigned as an inheritance share
key_terms.حَامِلًا: pregnant, indicating the woman was carrying a child
key_terms.قَرَابَةَ الْمَيِّتَةِ: the female deceased’s relatives who inherit the remaining share
key_terms.نِصْفَ الدِّيَةِ: half of the blood money given to an eligible heir

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali عليه السلام rule on inheritance and diyyah when a pregnant woman miscarried from fright and then died?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a legal judgment of Imam Ali عليه السلام after a battle, concerning a pregnant woman who miscarried from fright and then died. It establishes the order of inheritance between the child and mother, the distribution of the diyyah among heirs, and that the compensation was paid from the public treasury.
